title: Nuxt3使用Element Plus套件要注意的事
content:
### 核心 — 注意import方式

- 注意！最重要的！如果使用nuxt，組件一定要從`element-plus/dist/index.full`引入
    
    像是這樣
    
    ```tsx
    import { ElAutocomplete } from 'element-plus/dist/index.full';
    ```
    
- 有些組件要用ClientOnly包裹起來才行，像是ElAutoComplete
    
    ```tsx
    <client-only>
        <ElAutocomplete
            clearable
            :prefix-icon="Search"
            :trigger-on-focus="false"
            v-model="searchVal"
            :placeholder="placeholder"
            :fetch-suggestions="handleSearch"
            @select="handleSelect"
        />
    </client-only>
    ```
    

---
